recentItems.title: Putin’s fuel NOCKOUT the 15th “HIT” finishes off Russia’s STRATEGIC refinery!
recentItems.description:
Ukrainian drones carried out the 15th strike on the Saratov refinery: the strategic giant of the enemy’s oil industry is once again engulfed in flames, with critical units knocked out, deepening the fuel collapse in the occupiers’ army.

In response, the Kremlin launched another terrorist combined raid on Ukraine, cynically striking residential neighborhoods and civilian infrastructure in cities.

The punishment for the aggressor will be devastating: the United Kingdom is allocating an emergency air defense package worth £100 million with missiles for Patriot systems and confirming the transfer of a colossal armada of more than 120,000 drones to protect the skies and destroy the enemy!
